profile.headline: Software Engineer at Spectrum | React, Full-Stack & UX Design | Building pixel-perfect applications with 3+ years experience in React, FastAPI and Django.
profile.summary:
I am a software developer and designer, specialized in application development. 

My goal is to develop software that people enjoy using. Feel free to send me a message if you would like to know more about me. I am always eager to hear from others and expand my network on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Greenwood Village, Colorado, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Led front end development efforts of the automation department across 3 internal applications with hundreds of users. 
• Implemented a new reporting module in a high-traffic React application, increasing visibility of upper management.
• Collaborated with network, WiFi and video teams to develop an automated testing application for hardware devices, including 200+ devices in multiple locations across the country.
• Created a design system for consistent styling between different applications for the automation department. This included a library of reusable, modular components for both React and Angular frameworks and CSS module.
• Implemented enterprise SSO using JWT across internal applications.
• Utilized agile software methods and participated in spring planning and daily stand ups to ensure timely delivery.
positions.insights: React.js, Django REST Framework and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with diverse clients to provide expertise in data analysis, machine learning and full stack development.
• Created a full stack Django application for a client, resulting in 2-5x faster data retrieval performance.
• Contributed to open-source python packages including a python wrapper for locally-hosted LLMs with over 100 stars on GitHub.
• Added CI/CD pipeline for testing and deployment resulting in faster verification and build times for releases.
• Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication for public-facing application.

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed internal software tools with .NET framework and C# in the registrar office.
• Developed a web crawling application with selenium to automate administrative tasks, leading to 2-3x faster data processing.
• Documented and refactored legacy code, leading to increased efficiency.

positions.title: Student Transportation Ambassador
positions.description:
• Assisted in the day to day internal operations of the Environmental Center, mainly in the public transportation department. 
• Helped manage various projects, including the Environmental Center's ski bus for students. 
• Promoted sustainability events and services on campus through multiple outreach programs, leading to a 7% increase in sign-ups.
